content: {"paper_id":"W4401878734","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"deep-clustering","exact_quote":"we propose a new deep multi-view clustering network with a dual contrastive mechanism to learn clustering-friendly representations","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"该句提出深度多视图聚类网络，以可学习网络学习聚类友好表示并用于聚类，符合深度聚类定义。"},{"keyword_id":"multi-view-learning","exact_quote":"view-specific encoders to extract high-level features from each view, and an adaptive feature fusion strategy to obtain consensus representations across multiple views","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"对每个视图用独立编码器提取特征，并自适应融合多视图以获共识表示，显式联合利用多个视图。"},{"keyword_id":"contrastive-learning","exact_quote":"our method employs dual contrasting losses: a dynamic cluster diffusion loss to maximize the distance between different clusters and a reliable neighbor-guided positive alignment loss to enhance compactness within each cluster","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"采用双重对比损失，拉开不同簇距离并拉近簇内样本，属于通过样本/簇间吸引与区分学习表示。"},{"keyword_id":"pseudo-label-self-training","exact_quote":"improves within-cluster compactness through a pseudo-label and nearest neighbor structure-driven contrastive loss","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"伪标签与最近邻结构驱动对比损失，将模型生成的伪标签作为后续训练信号来提升簇内紧凑性。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
